parameters.query:
with ins as (
  insert into invoices_seen (file_hash, file_name) values ($1, $2)
  on conflict (file_hash) do nothing
  returning file_hash
)
select exists(select 1 from ins) as is_new

insert into invoice_exceptions (file_name, vendor, invoice_number, issues, extracted)
values ($1, $2, $3, array(select jsonb_array_elements_text($4::jsonb)), $5::jsonb)

insert into invoices_posted (vendor, invoice_number, bill_id, total, extracted)
values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb)

with failure as (
  insert into invoice_failures (file_name, node, error) values ($1, $2, $3)
  returning file_name, node, error
),
cleared as (
  delete from invoices_seen where file_hash = $4
)
select file_name, node, error from failure
